question: In VM v1.134.0, how much does the tagFilters->MetricIDs index cache contribute to full native query_range latency/CPU on the exact R01 3-day 2.49M fixture?
baseline: VictoriaMetrics v1.134.0 release SHA cd6e109bae85ff7c138d838b32be9a7fe2a6d7a9b3a387a7cf9234f22991da10, storage.cacheSizeIndexDBTagFilters=1 byte
candidate: Identical VM v1.134.0 executable with storage.cacheSizeIndexDBTagFilters=67108864 bytes (64MiB), no other changed flags
fixture: Frozen R01 400-node-slot 3d fixture sha256 ea9a8d43c9e58ed916f1bf43949556d8ed18169ddd14033c293af4cd54c9881d, 28896 series /2488320 points
single_variable: VM -storage.cacheSizeIndexDBTagFilters, 1 byte vs 64 MiB, fresh VM process per phase on identical cleanly stopped cloned imported storage
math_bound: Cache can save tagFilter->MetricIDs index searches, but not time-series sample reads or rollup cost. If index CPU fraction f, max whole-query speedup 1/(1-f); measure miss-rate and CPU instead of guessing f.
falsifier: Matching query output differs; high-cache misses not lower than low; background cache resets; A/A control drift over 25%; VM process OOM; physical fixture/hash differs; same run insufficient CPU stability.
test_matrix: Read-only VM fresh process cloned data, low/high/high/low, 8 warmups+48 measured single-client native PromQL requests per selector (node broad, pod namespace, pod broad, burst), source/fixture/binary parity and cache counter drift gates
runner_budget: single Ubuntu 24.04 GitHub Actions runner, no ClickHouse build, timeout 65 minutes, self-path push trigger, no scheduled workflows
ownership_boundaries: No overlap with R06/E03 planner, R05 marks, R07 metadata, or R21-24 CH dedup cache. This is VictoriaMetrics read-only index cache, not ClickHouse write cache.

test_matrix_details.caches: HTTP response cache off for both, VM tag filter cache capacity ON/OFF as sole factor
test_matrix_details.measure: native p50/p95, process CPU, VM tagfilter cache request/miss/reset counters, whole response oracle
